row.evidence: The Standard plan ($8 per user, per month) lists "Deploy users and groups with SCIM", and the provisioning docs say "This feature is available for the Standard, Premium, and Enterprise plans."
row.notes: SCIM sits on the cheapest paid tier, so No Tax. Provisioning is IdP-specific: SCIM for Okta and Microsoft Entra ID, plus a Google Workspace sync that pulls users and groups over Google APIs (not SCIM). The tailnet's sign-in IdP must be the same IdP, and provisioning is not supported for custom OIDC setups (for example JumpCloud), so there is no documented generic SCIM endpoint for other IdPs. OneLogin is a supported sign-in IdP, but the provisioning docs cover only Google, Entra and Okta. SCIM-provisioned users take no seat until first login; deprovisioning (suspend) frees the seat. Okta deletions do not sync; Entra hard-deletes after about 30 days. No SCIM Enterprise User extension. SSO (OIDC, no SAML), the user-management API, webhooks and configuration audit logs are on every plan, including free Personal (up to 6 users); the per-tier checkmarks were read from the pricing comparison table icons. The pricing page does not say whether $8 is the annual or monthly rate. No status change: new row. Under the post-pilot rules SCIM with two IdPs (Okta and Entra) is not partial, and SCIM is on the cheapest paid tier, so status stays free. Row idp.google is directory_sync (Tailscale-run Google Workspace sync, not SCIM). Users who sign in through the tailnet's OIDC identity provider for the first time join the tailnet (jit true, OIDC), optionally held for user approval.

auth.token_source: Admin console > User management > SCIM Provisioning > Enable Provisioning (Owner, Admin or IT admin); one SCIM API key per tailnet, pasted into the IdP as Secret Token (Entra) or API Token (Okta)

deprovision.data_retained: Suspended users' machines are suspended and can be deleted or reassigned; when Entra ID hard-deletes the user (about 30 days later) the user and their machines are deleted. Okta deactivation only suspends; deletion is manual in Tailscale.

custom.how: Attributes outside the listed set are stored without being used; Enterprise User extension attributes make the request fail.

roles.how: Synced groups cannot assign Tailscale roles; roles are set in the admin console or with POST /users/{userId}/role.

limitations.text: Provisioning works only with Okta, Microsoft Entra ID (SCIM) and Google Workspace (Google API sync); not supported for custom OIDC IdPs.
The tailnet's sign-in identity provider must be the same IdP that provisions (Entra ID, Google, or the Okta OIN app).
SCIM Enterprise User Schema Extension is not supported; requests containing its attributes fail.
Deletions cannot be synced from Okta; Okta deactivation suspends the user.
A user only suspended (not deactivated) in the IdP stays logged in until device keys expire.
Synced groups cannot be used to assign user roles.
Okta must use Email as the Application username format.
Entra ID syncs every 40 minutes; Google sync every 40 minutes and at most 100 groups.

rate_limits.text: No numeric limits published; the API documents a 429 Too Many Requests response, and invite resends are limited to one per minute.

limitations.text: No pagination: all results are returned at once.
API access tokens expire after 1 to 90 days; trust credentials (OAuth) give scoped, delegated access.
No endpoint creates a user directly; users are invited (POST /tailnet/{tailnet}/user-invites) or provisioned from the IdP.
Advanced roles (IT admin, Billing admin, Auditor, Network admin) need Standard or above.

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace user & group sync (Tailscale pulls users and groups via Google APIs every 40 minutes; not SCIM). Without provisioning, users join on first OIDC sign-in through the tailnet's IdP (optionally gated by user approval) or by invite.
